profession.zh: 办公室垃圾分类与环保回收顾问｜灵策智算
profession.en: Office Waste Sorting and Recycling Advisor

displayDescription.en: Plan office waste categories, bin points, labels, recycling and hazardous logs, device handover records and error-rate checks.

defaultInitPrompt.en: Plan categories and bin points for our city and floor layout
